description: Allowlist for the en-reference preservation gate (src/multilingual/en-reference-preservation.test.ts). Each key is a corpus unit (a plain row id, or <id>#<n> for the n-th `_` body of a markup row) whose English re-render — render(parse_en(src), "en") — drops or changes content, so all 23 translations inherit the loss. A new lossy unit, a changed render of a listed unit, and a listed unit that now passes all fail the gate. Shrinks only: deleting an entry is how a fix is completed. Regenerate with tools/regen-en-reference-baseline.ts.

async-block.family: BY DESIGN — the multilingual front-end strips `async` (engine-NULL row; core deleted `async` in #1102)
async-block.rendered: on click fetch "/api/data" then put it into me

behavior-draggable.family: TRIAGE — `init` reordered after the handler (as behavior-removable: the handler's `from dragHandle` is evaluated at install)
behavior-draggable.rendered:
behavior Draggable(dragHandle)
  on pointerdown(clientX, clientY) from dragHandle halt the event then trigger draggable:start then measure x then set startX to it then measure y then set startY to it then set xoff to clientX - startX then set yoff to clientY - startY then repeat until event pointerup from document wait for pointermove(clientX, clientY) or pointerup(clientX, clientY) from document then add { left : $ { clientX - xoff } px ; top : $ { clientY - yoff } px ; } then trigger draggable:move end then trigger draggable:end
  end
  init
    if no dragHandle set dragHandle to me end
  end
end
lost: init if no dragHandle set dragHandle to me end
added: end end init if no dragHandle set dragHandle to me

behavior-removable.family: TRIAGE — `init` reordered after the handler (`from triggerEl` is evaluated at install)
behavior-removable.rendered:
behavior Removable(triggerEl, confirmRemoval, effect)
  on click from triggerEl if confirmRemoval js (me)
        if (!window.confirm("Are you sure?")) return "cancel"; end then if it is "cancel" halt end end then trigger removable:before then if effect is "fade" transition opacity to 0 over 300ms end then trigger removable:removed then remove me
  end
  init
    if triggerEl is undefined set triggerEl to me end
  end
end
lost: init if triggerEl is undefined set triggerEl to me end end
added: end init if triggerEl is undefined set triggerEl to me

behavior-sortable.family: TRIAGE — `init` reordered after the handler (as behavior-removable); `the` before `target` dropped
behavior-sortable.rendered:
behavior Sortable(dragClass)
  on pointerdown(clientY) set item to target.closest("li") then if item is null exit end then halt the event then add .{dragClass} to item then trigger sortable:start on me then repeat until event pointerup from document wait for pointermove(clientY) or pointerup(clientY) from document then trigger sortable:move on me end then remove .{dragClass} from item then trigger sortable:end on me
  end
  init
    if dragClass is undefined set dragClass to "sorting" end
  end
end
lost: init if dragClass is undefined set dragClass to "sorting" end end
added: end init if dragClass is undefined set dragClass to "sorting"

event-debounce.family: TRIAGE — naked `${…}` URL rendered quoted (does the interpolation survive?)
event-debounce.rendered: on input debounced at 300ms fetch "/api/search?q=${my value}" as json then put it into #results

event-once.family: TRIAGE — source `on click once` is invalid on BOTH engines; render emits `click.once`
event-once.rendered: on click.once add .initialized to me then call setup()

eventsource-basic.rendered:
eventsource ChatStream
  on message put it into #messages
  end
end

fetch-do-not-throw.rendered: on click fetch "/api/users" as JSON then if it set $users to it end

form-disable-on-submit.rendered: on submit add @disabled to <button/> then put "Submitting..." into <button/>

socket-basic.rendered:
socket ChatSocket
  on message put it into #chat
  end
end

stagger-animation.rendered: on load repeat for item in .item add .visible to item then wait 100ms end
